notes: Modal is validated with the installed official CLI using MODAL_SERVER_URL.
Modal publishes its control-plane contract as protobuf/gRPC, not an official REST OpenAPI; the REST-like routes are an emulator facade over that schema.
The complete official api.proto is vendored; 31 stateful unary RPCs cover token, workspace, environment, app, secret, and volume lifecycle flows.
Current conformance focuses on token info and app listing flows.
The /modal/forge/inference route is a deterministic Forge test seam and does not emulate real container execution.
